description: This file defines a Java servlet filter class 'SameSiteFilter' that adds the 'SameSite' attribute to cookies in HTTP responses to enhance security. It reads configuration properties to determine the attribute value and modifies the 'Set-Cookie' headers accordingly during request processing.

classes.name: SameSiteFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that appends a 'SameSite' attribute to cookies to improve security against CSRF attacks. It retrieves the attribute value from configuration properties and modifies 'Set-Cookie' headers in HTTP responses.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter; currently a no-op.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes each request, passes it along the filter chain, then adds the 'SameSite' attribute to all 'Set-Cookie' headers in the response.

methods.name: addSameSiteCookieAttribute
methods.description: Iterates through all 'Set-Cookie' headers in the response and appends the 'SameSite' attribute with the configured value.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is taken out of service; currently a no-op.
